rules.title: Use a cap within the competitive band
rules.why: This target requires 125–250 fps. A cap of 250 satisfies the verified band.
rules.notice: The saved cap becomes 250. This does not prove that your Mac sustains 250 fps or establish a movement advantage.
rules.evidence: Policy correction from the saved frame cap; sustained FPS and movement are Not measured.

sources.quote: com_maxFps->limits.integer.min = 125; com_maxFps->limits.integer.max = 250; if (com_maxFps->value.integer < 125 || com_maxFps->value.integer > 250) { Dvar_SetInt(com_maxFps, 250); // it will also set the latched value }

rules.title: Use the current mouse sample
rules.why: Mouse filtering averages the current and previous samples. Turning it off is an optional input preference.
rules.notice: Mouse movement uses the current sample rather than the two-sample average. Sensitivity stays as saved.
rules.evidence: Effect follows the mouse-move code; input latency and polling are Not measured.

rules.title: Use a constant mouse scale
rules.why: Acceleration adds a speed-dependent term to sensitivity. Zero removes that term; this is a preference, not a league requirement.
rules.notice: For the same mouse distance, the acceleration term no longer changes your turn with mouse speed. ADS and weapon scaling still apply.
rules.evidence: Effect follows the sensitivity formula; player performance is Not measured.

rules.title: Request the verified rate ceiling
rules.why: 25000 is the verified client rate ceiling and the competitive target. Actual traffic is also limited by the server.
rules.notice: Your requested bandwidth cap becomes 25000 bytes/s. This does not establish lower ping or packet loss.
rules.evidence: Configuration and registration ceilings only; no connection improvement is measured.

rules.title: Request snapshots for this client version
rules.why: Stock 1.3 permits up to 30; CoD2x permits up to 40. The selected policy determines which value is valid.
rules.notice: Your requested snapshot rate changes. The server controls the actual delivery rate; it may remain lower.
rules.evidence: Configuration and registration ceilings only; no connection improvement is measured.

rules.title: Use the packet cap for this client version
rules.why: The verified client maximum is 100 for stock and 125 for CoD2x. Packet sending also depends on frame timing.
rules.notice: Your outgoing packet cap changes. Ping, packet loss and actual packet cadence are Not measured.
rules.evidence: Configuration and registration ceilings only; no connection improvement is measured.

rules.title: Avoid the contested texture level
rules.why: zPAM authors list picmip 3 as abusable. Some league texts allow it, so this is conservative advice rather than a universal prohibition. Manual mode must also be enabled so renderer setup retains the saved mip levels.
rules.notice: Picmip becomes 2, retaining a more detailed mip level than 3. Frame-time impact is Not measured. Manual mode keeps your saved normal-map and specular mip levels too.
rules.evidence: Conservative inference from a known-bug note, not a measured visibility or performance score.

sources.quote: [5.12] r_picmip can be abused, find a way to make sure picmip 3 cant be used

rules.title: Keep the full texture mip chain
rules.why: Lower picmip keeps higher-resolution mip levels in the texture upload path. Choose this when you prefer detail. Manual mode must also be enabled so renderer setup retains the saved mip levels.
rules.notice: Textures eligible for picmip retain the full mip chain after the texture reload. Memory and frame-time costs are Not measured. Manual mode keeps your saved normal-map and specular mip levels too.
rules.evidence: Texture upload behavior; neither available GPU headroom nor an FPS change is measured.
